ann: The chaotic crowd abruptly quiets down as the speaker takes the center of the court and prepares to begin his speech.
The speaker introduces his core message of handling adversity by focusing on the "next play."
The speaker begins an anecdote about a tribe catching monkeys using coconuts
The speaker concludes the speech by urging the students to "let go" and keep marching forward
Climax of the speech, crowd starts applauding and the speaker steps away from the microphone.
A bunch of people gather around in a formation, music starts and they start dancing.
The speaker starts dancing as the crowd is applauding for him and he joins the dancing band afterwards.
The staff begins their synchronized flash mob dance routine to upbeat pop music
The dancing band start dancing in sync as the crowd is cheering for them.
The music changes and the band starts another in sync dance.
The flash mob continues with high-energy, synchronized arm movements as the crowd cheers
The song changes again and another dance starts.
The band lays on the floor, as the dance and music stops, the crowd cheers the loudest.
The band goes back into the stands.
A woman takes the microphone and encourages the crowd to applaud once again.
pred: A bald man is standing on an indoor basketball court and talking to someone off camera while holding two microphones. He then bends down towards another person who appears to have fallen or collapsed onto their knees. The other people around them react by kneeling as well
